# Extract the crowd size for each game, converting to numeric
df['crowd_numeric'] = df['crowd'].astype(int)

# Sort by crowd size descending and get the ranking
df_sorted = df.sort_values(by='crowd_numeric', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
df_sorted['crowd_rank'] = df_sorted.index + 1  # rank 1 for largest

# Filter for the collingwood vs melbourne game
collingwood_melbourne_mask = ((df_sorted['home team'] == 'collingwood') & (df_sorted['away team'] == 'melbourne')) | \
                             ((df_sorted['home team'] == 'melbourne') & (df_sorted['away team'] == 'collingwood'))
collingwood_melbourne_row = df_sorted[collingwood_melbourne_mask]

# Check if the game exists and has crowd rank 3
if not collingwood_melbourne_row.empty:
    # Perform ranking operation: check if rank equals 3
    answer = (collingwood_melbourne_row['crowd_rank'].iloc[0] == 3)
else:
